why: The FKT West Ridge C2C page climbs the south-side couloir from Boston Basin to the notch and then the ridge; Climber Kyle, Steph Abegg and The Mountaineers describe the West Ridge route the same way.
FKT and WTA both describe Sunrise Mine Trail, crossing Vesper Creek, then the granite slabs up the central rib, and SummitBorn calls that the standard route, matching ours.
